stack: ROCm 7.0.2 with its ASan runtime libraries
PyTorch 2.10.0 built from source with -fsanitize=address for gfx950:xnack+
runs.run_mode: aorta run --sanitizer asan, proposed in PR #567 (not yet merged)
notes: aorta run has no option for workload configuration yet, and hrx must be built for gfx950 on MI350, so the hrx rows ran through the same run-mode entry point from Python, with the configuration shown.

PyTorch's own kernels are checked only because PyTorch is built with ASan: with the stock PyTorch wheel the same gpu_smoke run checks 0 of its 3 kernels (measured 2026-10-20), since the wheel ships device code without ASan.

Not covered, measured on this stack: shared-memory (LDS) accesses inside PyTorch's kernels, because this build turns off ASan's LDS lowering, without which some PyTorch softmax kernels fail to launch on gfx950; stores made with buffer instructions; hipMallocManaged memory; and accesses far outside an allocation. A pass covers what ASan instruments, not every access.
